answer: Proposed: pay agents per filled umber pigment or quartz order, not per key. Each paid key needs a fresh receipt for a 1 kg order. A trusted depot assays, weighs and retains purchases until dawn, then signs key/order receipts; validators pay each order once. Invalid or reused receipts earn nothing. Inventory purchases recur; trucks are reusable capital, with no stake. Shared trucks lower freight, but parallel keys cannot reuse goods. Depot collusion defeats this. Ten keys filling ten orders need 10 x 1 kg and earn the same total as one key filling those orders.
